quality.basis: 第五类无法转化成有效任务：Linux 上 setsockopt 设过大缓冲永不失败（内核截断），被删掉的重试循环走不到，两版行为一致

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: on Linux setsockopt(SO_RCVBUF/SO_SNDBUF) never fails for an oversized value (the kernel clamps to the rmem_max/wmem_max limit), so the removed retry loop is never entered and the two builds behave identically; nothing observable differs and the exploit only checks that a backgrounded server is still alive.

review.note: starts turnutils_peer in the background and calls it triggered if it is still running 2 s later; sanitizer_report.txt is empty

category5.design: The injected code makes set_sock_buf_size call setsockopt once and break instead of halving on failure. On Linux setsockopt never fails for an oversized buffer (it clamps), so the retry loop is dead and the builds are identical. No PoV can separate them; the spec keeps the turnutils_peer CLI (which contains apputils.c) and marks the task unusable.
